verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents customizable notifications for recurring manual obligations such as annual penetration testing and quarterly access reviews, and an overdue-task view, which implies tasks carry due dates. It also supports custom fields on Tasks. None of this is described specifically as a workflow for manual evidence artifacts. Missing for 10: explicit manual-evidence upload workflow, per-artifact owner assignment, expiry tracking on uploaded artifacts, renewal reminders tied to artifact expiry, independent or hands-on corroboration.
